description: Derived: the outline of every shape of one slide, layout or master whose geometry is a named preset and whose box is known, computed by the writing application. A reader uses it instead of implementing the presets.

owner.description: The node_id of the slide, layout or master the outlines belong to.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1.

shapes.description: One entry per shape with a preset geometry and a box of its own, in depth-first order.

d.description: The outline in the shape's own space, in points: (0,0) is the top-left corner of the shape's box before rotation and flips. Commands separated by single spaces, absolute coordinates: `M x y`, `L x y`, `C x1 y1 x2 y2 x y`, `Q x1 y1 x y`, `Z`.

even_odd.description: true: the sub-path is filled by the even-odd rule (holes); false: non-zero winding.

fill.description: How the sub-path is filled (as `custom_path.fill` in the owner's schema).

stroke.description: The sub-path is outlined with the shape's line.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer of the shape within the owner node's payload, e.g. `/slide/shapes/2` or `/slide/shapes/4/kind/children/0`.

preset.description: The preset name the outline was generated from.

text_rect.description: The rectangle text is laid out in, in the shape's own space: x0, y0, x1, y1.

w.description: The box width the outline was generated for, points.

title: core.slide.geometry
